discovery_expectations.text: Tests split_payment with parts=0 (zero division bug)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test_edge_cases.py line 321-323: TestSplitPaymentEdgeCases::test_zero_parts_raises_zero_division_error asserts pytest.raises(ZeroDivisionError) when calling split_payment(100.0, 0). Bug confirmed real: price_calculator.py line 51 does round(total / parts, 2) with no guard.

discovery_expectations.text: Tests negative price values in calculate_discount or calculate_total
discovery_expectations.evidence: test_edge_cases.py line 39-42: test_negative_price_with_discount calls calculate_discount(-50.0, 10) and asserts result == -45.0, documenting that negative prices are accepted with no error.

discovery_expectations.text: Tests calculate_total with empty items list

discovery_expectations.text: Tests floating point rounding edge cases

format_expectations.text: Documents at least one discovered bug as a skipped test with BUG notation — look for test.skip or pytest.mark.skip with "BUG" in the test name
format_expectations.evidence: No pytest.mark.skip or test.skip decorators found anywhere in test_edge_cases.py. Bugs are documented only via inline comments (e.g. '# BUG: no guard') within passing tests that assert the buggy behaviour. The format requirement for skipped tests with BUG notation in the test name is not met.

format_expectations.text: Provides a structured test coverage summary at the end — look for summary.md
format_expectations.evidence: summary.md exists in the outputs directory with a structured format including: existing test coverage table, 11 numbered bugs with severity and description, and a coverage gaps table per function.

quality_expectations.text: Generated tests compile and run without syntax errors
quality_expectations.evidence: Running 'python -m pytest test_edge_cases.py -q' from /tmp with price_calculator.py present produces: '59 passed in 0.05s' with no syntax errors, import errors, or collection errors.

quality_expectations.text: Skipped BUG tests actually fail when unskipped (bug is real, not a false positive)
